_comment: Fallback author lists for papers OpenAlex does not index yet, keyed
tools/build_paper_authors.py, which uses an entry here ONLY when the OpenAlex
cache has no author list for that key. So an override retires itself: once
OpenAlex indexes the paper, the real record silently wins and this entry stops
being consulted. Names must be verbatim and in submission order, since
js/pub-authors.js shows them as the paper's full author list.
Entry numbers move when a section is renumbered. paper-authors.json is rebuilt
from scratch each run so it self-heals, but an override is hand-keyed: recheck
these keys after moving entries around.
